description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, measured by BPC (bits per character) over a range of training steps. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps", is plotted on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 0 to 50,000 (indicated by "(x10^4)" at the right end), with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "BPC", is linear and ranges from 1.2 to 2.2. The plot displays two lines: the black line with star markers, labeled "SMoE Validating", starts at approximately 2.2 BPC and decreases sharply to a plateau near 1.4 BPC by around 10,000 training steps, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The magenta line with diamond markers, labeled "SimSMoE Validating", begins at approximately 2.2 BPC, follows a similar sharp decline to around 1.4 BPC by 10,000 steps, and then also stabilizes near 1.4 BPC, closely following the black line for the remainder of the training steps shown.
